name: speedometer
description: A pane with a context-window speedometer, an activity badge, rate limits, cost, model and turn stats

theme.title: Gauge cluster
theme.description: The look of the pane. classic: three plain dials. minimal: no gauges, only context, cost, model, turns and agents. Plain styles: bars, rings, battery, digital, columns. Vehicle dashboards: eighties-digital-dash, silver-bezel, hex-supercar, five-dial-sports, spartan-supercar, neon-grid, race-wheel, boost-screen, scanner-dash, fifties-chrome, chrono-console, nineties-rally. Beyond the road: vu-meter, weather-station, steampunk, hourglass, retro-arcade.

gauge1.title: Main gauge
gauge1.description: What the main gauge shows. auto: the 5-hour window, or the weekly window on a plan with no 5-hour limit. Or pick one: five-hour, weekly, model-weekly, context (context window fill).

gauge2.title: Second gauge
gauge2.description: What the second gauge shows. auto: the weekly window, or context fill on a plan with no 5-hour limit. Or pick one: five-hour, weekly, model-weekly, context (context window fill).

gauge3.title: Third gauge
gauge3.description: What the third gauge shows. auto: the per-model weekly window (needs Read per-model limits). Or pick one: five-hour, weekly, model-weekly, context (context window fill).

usageEndpoint.title: Read per-model limits
usageEndpoint.description: Ask https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage, at most once a minute, for the per-model weekly window. The request uses the session's own sign-in through Claude Code; the plugin never sees the token. Off: no network request is made, and only the 5-hour and weekly windows Claude Code reports are shown.

wallClock.title: Count every hour
wallClock.description: Project burn rate over every hour of every day. Off: only the work day set below, Monday to Friday unless Count weekends is on.

workStart.title: Work day starts
workStart.description: Used only when Count every hour is off: projections count time from this to the end of the work day, as HH:MM local. Equal start and end counts every hour.

workEnd.title: Work day ends
workEnd.description: Used only when Count every hour is off. HH:MM local.

weekends.title: Count weekends
weekends.description: Used only when Count every hour is off: count Saturday and Sunday in projections. Off: Monday to Friday only.
